title: Sown's Modding Framework
description: This project is the foundation for all mods by Sown
body:
Introduction: Sown's Modding Framework provides an essential infrastructure for my Minecraft mod development. As the foundation for all Sown-produced mods, this framework is designed for efficiency, stability, and inter-mod compatibility.

Key Features:

1. Centralized Base: Ensures a seamless interaction among all affiliated mods. 2. Easy Integration: Allows for quick and hassle-free incorporation into various Minecraft mods. 3. Ongoing Updates: Regularly updated to optimize performance, improve stability, and introduce new features for better mod compatibility.

Requirement: To ensure full functionality and compatibility, the Sown Modding Framework is required when using any Sown mod.

Support: We value the feedback and insights of our user community. Should you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please reach out via our dedicated Discord channels.
